name: Meltdown's Level 2+ discount and destroy target domain/item/weapon
notes: The starting champion is patched with 2 level counters (ObjectCurrentLevel() = CardLevel + level-counter count) to reach the [Level 2+] discount without scripting a real level-up, reducing the 4-reserve cost to 3. Clarent, Sword of Peace is seeded onto the opponent's field as the destroy target; the destroy effect (DoSacrificeFighter/DoAllyDestroyed) resolves by banishing the target into its owner's banish zone, not their graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Level 2+] This card costs 1 less to activate.
Destroy target domain, item, or weapon.
